observations.trace: Staging::stage returns Staged(usize) with no session identity, and StagedResults::get uses that ordinal directly; prefix only truncates and status indexes the first value. DevicePart::stage returns copyable PartSlots and DevicePart::finish accepts an independently supplied StagedResults and PartSlots; PartBuild::finish uses those statuses and arrays with its own layout, truncating positions, normals and indices to maximum counts without checking required lengths. Two separate batches may have the same slot ordinals, and one shared batch may contain slots for two different parts. In the latter source-level scenario, finishing larger part A using smaller part B slots reads B statuses and buffers while taking faces and grids from A. Valid Spaulder designs with seven versus two lames supply different numbers of chart shells; each has no optional textile slot when the selected recipe leaves textile_chart false.
observations.remaining: No parts, batches, staging buffers, reads, GPU work or resulting mesh ran. The mismatch example assumes both constructions and readback succeed, B statuses are zero, and no other earlier error intervenes. Native Readback preserves recorded byte order and checks extent arithmetic, but it does not bind these public logical handles to a DevicePart. Original q2274 cross-session and q2275 same-session wrong-part/required-count subcontracts remain distinct under q140; full consumer and native cast/error audit remains open.

observations.trace: record_wrapped_tassets calls GarmentArmorDesign::validate and requires WrappedTassets. That validation delegates shape validation, requires Tassets kind, bounds lame_count1..12 and section_break below lame_count, so the selected course divisions and the difference between top and bottom have nonzero count under this path. The creator passes left/right fit and status buffers, records a copy of both status words into the part status, and schedules a later support check. The native carrier and shape source have additional height and hull-count denominators whose fit metadata comes from a separate owner.
observations.remaining: Source and bounded arithmetic only; no geometry, fit, shader, status or support check ran. Actual hull/height admission and all public callers are still open; the selected creator status copy is not evidence for arbitrary external callers.

observations.trace: The original independent Adler350 source review already noted that fillets with line0.2 may consume the available motif room and may deliberately hide the figure. The current ornament trace adds the selected line0.18 example, default positive Wave amplitude, editor-control and host/shader path; it must not be represented as a previously unobserved historical issue.
observations.remaining: No UI, ornament or shader ran. Intended policy for wide fillets remains open. The earlier receipt and newly assessed example remain independently attributed, with no new original unique count or checkpoint3821 claim.

observations.trace: skin::blend merges weighted influences by typed joint ordinal, retains the heaviest eight and renormalizes; zero total intentionally returns the first skin. Source callers include the tiling surface interpolation and trim-edge interpolation. Original Adler350 already identified nonfinite or extreme shares/weights as conditional on upstream admission.
observations.remaining: The current selected source reads do not establish the full GridSurface corner/share and rig-weight admission or an actual invalid supported input. No blend, tiling, trim or product ran; earlier conditional concern remains open without claiming a fresh independent defect.
